10214a98b6745bfa50b98b52d0637fbb.pythonCode:
import pandas as pd

rows = datasets['b6ccd3e24ae5227ca62f2b8da0110508']
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
assert len(df) == 24, len(df)
assert not df.duplicated(['order_year', 'order_month']).any()
p = df.pivot(index='order_month', columns='order_year', values=['order_count', 'subtotal_sum']).sort_index()
out = pd.DataFrame({
    'month': p.index.astype(int),
    'month_label': [f'{int(m)}月' for m in p.index],
    'order_count_2002': p[('order_count', 2002)].astype(int).to_numpy(),
    'order_count_2003': p[('order_count', 2003)].astype(int).to_numpy(),
    'subtotal_2002': p[('subtotal_sum', 2002)].astype(float).to_numpy(),
    'subtotal_2003': p[('subtotal_sum', 2003)].astype(float).to_numpy(),
})
out['subtotal_yoy_pct'] = ((out['subtotal_2003'] / out['subtotal_2002'] - 1) * 100).round(2)
out['order_count_yoy_pct'] = ((out['order_count_2003'] / out['order_count_2002'] - 1) * 100).round(2)
out['order_count_yoy_display'] = out['order_count_yoy_pct'].map(lambda v: f'{v:+.2f}%')
out['subtotal_2002_display'] = out['subtotal_2002'].map(lambda v: f'{v:,.2f}')
out['subtotal_2003_display'] = out['subtotal_2003'].map(lambda v: f'{v:,.2f}')
out['subtotal_yoy_display'] = out['subtotal_yoy_pct'].map(lambda v: f'{v:+.2f}%')
assert len(out) == 12
result = out.to_dict('records')
